description.narrative: Mongolia - Property Rights Project - Project Administration Costs activity: Contains costs for project administration. The Improvement of the Land Privatization and Registration System Activity and the Privatization & Registration of Ger Area Land Plots Activity will be implemented by a project implementation unit housed within the Ministry of Roads, Transport, Construction and Urban Development. The Peri-Urban Land Leasing Activity will be implemented by a project implementation unit housed within the Ministry of Food, Agriculture and Light Industry.
